title: Twitter’s Quest for a Wholly Graal Runtime by Chris Thalinger
summary: Chris Thalinger of Twitter describes the company's effort to run its Scala services on the Graal JIT compiler at Scala Days NYC 2018. It covers the performance gains Twitter saw and the work of running Graal in production.
why: HN cites it as public evidence that Twitter ran GraalVM in production and saw significant performance improvements.

quote.text: Twitter has some talks on this where they claim signifiant performance improvements
